game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Molten Bridge, a bridge over magma: the ember mage must handle magma slimes while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Arithmetic Cannon: Choose +, -, *, / or // to build a damage formula that exactly matches a shield number on magma slimes.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Molten Bridge: a bridge over magma
core_gameplay_loop: In Molten Bridge, repeat each round: Choose +, -, *, / or // to build a damage formula that exactly matches a shield number on magma slimes. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the damage value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Reach the cooling vent using at most 16 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: The cooling vent reached with actions_used <= 16.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 16 before the cooling vent is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 5 (applied tier): Arithmetic Cannon
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Arithmetic Cannon' (Week 2 slot 2), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Molten Bridge'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how damage changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against magma slimes in Molten Bridge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The cooling vent reached with actions_used <= 16.
